title: Maximize Sum After At Most K Digit Rearrangements
statement: The task is to maximize an array's sum when at most k elements may each have their decimal digits rearranged, with n up to 10^5 and values up to 10^9. Each element's best rearrangement is its digits sorted descending, giving an independent nonnegative gain, so the problem reduces to greedily adding the k largest gains after sorting them.
